# Aditya Verma

> Systems & Backend Developer · Electronics Engineering Student · Arch Linux AUR Maintainer

Aditya Verma is a systems and backend developer based in Mumbai, India, studying
Electronics & Telecommunications at Mumbai University (2026–2030). He writes C, C++,
Rust and Python for Linux, embedded systems (ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi) and
open-source software. He maintains Arch Linux AUR packages and founded the open-source
community TheCodeVerseHub. His motto: Code. Study. Research. Repeat.

  programmer (2021–present), founder of TheCodeVerseHub (2023–present)
- Site: https://aditya-verma.me
